name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      src: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.src }}
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            src:
              - '**'
              - '!.planning/**'
              - '!.learnings/**'
              - '!docs/**'
              - '!designs/**'
              - '!00-Preliminary-R&D/**'
              - '!.claude/**'
              - '!**/*.md'
              - '!LICENSE'
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/**'
              - '.github/workflows/ci.yml'

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run linter
        run: pnpm lint

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run type checker
        run: pnpm typecheck

  api-spec:
    name: Verify API Spec & Client
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate OpenAPI spec and API client
        run: pnpm api:generate
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Format generated files
        run: |
          pnpm eslint --fix apps/web/src/api/ || true
          pnpm prettier --write packages/api-client/openapi.json apps/web/src/api/

      - name: Verify no uncommitted changes to generated files
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code packages/api-client/openapi.json || (echo "OpenAPI spec is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)
          git diff --exit-code apps/web/src/api/ || (echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)

  test:
    name: Test
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run API tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test:cov
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Run Crypto tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto test:coverage

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./apps/api/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/crypto/coverage/lcov.info
          flags: api,crypto
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck, api-spec, test]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build packages (excluding desktop)
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto --filter @cipherbox/api --filter @cipherbox/web build

  cargo-check-windows:
    name: Cargo Check (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

        id: release-check

          if [[ "${{ github.head_ref }}" == release-please--branches--* ]]; then
            echo "is_release_please=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        if: steps.release-check.outputs.is_release_please != 'true'
        with:

              - '!LICENSE'

              - 'apps/desktop/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/**'
              - '.github/workflows/ci.yml'

    name: Lint

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      src: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.src }}
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            src:
              - '**'
              - '!.planning/**'
              - '!.learnings/**'
              - '!docs/**'
              - '!designs/**'
              - '!00-Preliminary-R&D/**'
              - '!.claude/**'
              - '!**/*.md'
              - '!LICENSE'
              - '!**/package.json'
              - '!**/Cargo.toml'
              - '!**/tauri.conf.json'
              - '!.release-please-manifest.json'

              - 'apps/desktop/**'
              - '!apps/desktop/package.json'

              - '!apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json'
              - 'packages/crypto/**'
              - '!packages/crypto/package.json'
              - '.github/workflows/ci.yml'

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

content.text:
Here's how this works:

**`src` filter** — added 4 exclusions:
- `!**/package.json` — all package.json files across the monorepo
- `!**/Cargo.toml` — Cargo manifests
- `!**/tauri.conf.json` — Tauri config
- `!.release-please-manifest.json` — Release Please tracking file

**`desktop` filter** — added exclusions inline after each include:
- `!apps/desktop/package.json`, `!apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml`, `!apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json` — for the `apps/desktop/**` group
- `!packages/crypto/package.json` — for the `packages/crypto/**` group

**Why this is safe:** Version bumps only touch these manifest files. Any real change (new dependency, code change, config change) will also modify other files:
- New npm dependency → `pnpm-lock.yaml` changes → matches `**`
- New Rust dependency → `Cargo.lock` changes → matches `apps/desktop/**`
- Code changes → `.ts`/`.rs` files change → always matched

So a Release Please PR with only version bumps → `src=false`, `desktop=false` → expensive jobs skip. A feature PR that happens to also bump a version → other changed files still trigger CI normally.

- Excludes `package.json`, `Cargo.toml`, `tauri.conf.json`, and `.release-please-manifest.json` from the CI change detection filters
- Prevents Release Please PRs (which only bump version fields) from triggering expensive CI jobs like Windows/macOS desktop builds, tests, and API spec verification
- Real dependency changes are still caught via lockfile modifications (`pnpm-lock.yaml`, `Cargo.lock`) which continue to match the filters

## Test plan
- [ ] Verify normal feature PRs still trigger full CI as expected
- [ ] Verify the next Release Please PR skips expensive jobs (test, build, cargo-check, desktop builds)
